Product Features

  • Measuring 100 x 50 x 35 cm, this golden format is specially designed for small homes, saving space while enhancing the aesthetics of the living room.
  • The central, hollowed-out, layered design and open storage space allow magazines and various items to be neatly placed and easily accessed.
  • The surface is high-gloss, smooth and easy to wipe clean. Coffee stains and dust can be removed with a wipe, making daily care child's play.
  • The built-in LED ambient light strip allows you to switch between warm and cold light at will, instantly enhancing the atmosphere of your living room at night.
  • Thanks to its free-standing design and the lack of blind spots on the underside, the robot vacuum cleaner can move freely and clean without obstacles.
  • The minimalist white color scheme, combined with the understated luxury of gold, is characterized by clean and elegant lines, making it suitable for various interior styles, including modern and Scandinavian.
  • Made of high-quality chipboard, it has a sturdy and durable construction, is environmentally friendly and harmless to health, and provides safety for use at home.
  • The three-dimensional arrangement with upper and lower levels creates a transparent appearance and expands storage space, combining functionality and aesthetics.
  • Minimalist design language, no more complicated decoration – this makes the living room of a small apartment look more spacious and brighter.

Descriptions

Descriptions

This 100 x 50 x 35 cm coffee table features a hollowed-out centre compartment with storage, a large level shelf (made of high-gloss material) for easy cleaning and integrated LED lighting. Its simple and elegant design is ideal for small apartments. Thanks to the stand construction, there are no corners that are difficult to clean. Made of chipboard.

App application and manager:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.
